About our prices
If you're a new client, we usually can't pin down an exact price at first... That's just because we haven't seen your pet, and may not know things like the length of hair and condition of coat (snarls or tangles), the size of the dog and the behavior of the dog.
Sometimes, the same dog dog can cost a different amount at different times! For example, a large breed with a lot of undercoat, like an English Sheep Dog, could cost $75 one visit because it took about an hour of pretty intense work, may cost $200+ another time that the undercoat is the heaviest and it's shedding, and it took 3 hours of intense work!
In short, it's impossible to give an exact quote. With that in mind, we've listed the basics for pricing below. This all assumes and average amount of effort and a well-behaved puppy. We always treat your pet with the utmost kindness and gentleness, but some pets that don't care for the grooming process may take longer - at first - but Jay will work to turn grooming into a positive experience for your pet - which may take a while. That's why these offerings are in the price ranges below...
If you have questions about the above or below, you can always
call us at 570-209-8660!
As payment, we accept cash, checks, venmo, zelle and debit/credit cards.
Baths - Price below usually require more (and up) for longer hair breeds for drying and de-shedding
$10 and up - small short hair
$20 and up - short hair medium to large dogs
$30 and up - short hair giant breeds
Ear & Eye Cleaning - About $10-15
Full Grooming - (Includes: as needed - bath, nails, shaves, trims, ears, eyes, anal gland expression, etc). Starts at $45 and up for small simple breeds. Medium breeds start closer to $60 and up, Larger Breeds start at around $75 and go up based on the time it takes - Comb out all matts and/or shave, trim all areas for maximum hygeine and breed look. We will groom to your specifications! In general, the longer it takes the more we charge although it is not a "per hour" charge. Large dogs with a lot of hair cost more...
Note: Always specify ALL your pet information when making an appointment. See you soon!

We also offer tailored behavioral training and basic obedience. Jay will need to speak with you on the phone about your needs before making an appointment and cost estimate.
